 1 | Balance | caster | varies | self | U

 3 | Face Shifting | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
 5 | Waterlungs | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
 7 | Change to Kind | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
 8 | Gaslungs | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

11 | Changing Lungs | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
13 | Change | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
15 | Solid Form | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
18 | Shapechanging | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
20 | Waterform | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
25 | Mistform | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
30 | Form Master | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
50 | Change Master | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Gives a special bonus of +50 to any rolls for one slow maneuver requiring
balance (e.g., walking a 3'' beam, etc.).
@@ 2
Allows caster to disjoint limbs, contract muscles, etc. to escape
manacles/ropes and to slip through small places. Gives a special bonus of +25
to +50 to Contortions maneuvers.
@@ 3
Allows caster to alter the form of his face. The caster may specify a specific
person, but the change will not be exact.
@@ 5
For the duration, the caster can breathe water but not air.
@@ 7
Caster can alter his form to the form of any desired humanoid race. The form
cannot be a specific form. For example, a human caster could take on the form
of a Dwarf, but not the Dwarven king. Only physical form is gained (e.g., a
target who becomes a Dwarf would not receive the Dwarves’ ability to see in
the dark). The caster can only alter his size by up to 25%.
@@ 8
As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe any gas as normal air.
@@ 10
As Face Shifting, except lasts 1 hour per level.
@@ 11
As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe any air, water, and/or gas, at will.
@@ 13
As Change to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within 50% to
200% of the caster’s current mass; does not confer any special abilities.
@@ 15
Caster becomes as if made of very dense stone (cannot move or cast spells).
@@ 18
As Change, except caster may assume a different form anytime during the spell.
The change takes one round of concentration.
@@ 20
Caster takes the form of a liquid mass, able to seep through cracks as well as
water. As a fluid, he can move through water at a rate of 10 mph. The caster
may not cast spells while in this form.
@@ 25
Caster takes the form of a mist, able to fly at a rate of 20 mph. The caster
may seep through cracks, extend himself to become virtually invisible, etc.
The caster may not cast spells in this form.
@@ 30
As Waterform and Mistform, except the two forms are interchangeable at will.
Changin from one form to another takes one round of concentration.
@@ 50
As Changing and Form Master, except all forms are interchangeable at will.
Each change takes one round of concentration. The caster may vary his mass
between 10% and 1000% of his own mass.
